apadesa.p: [Apa+disa+ṇa] (pu) CL=9 (1) intension, intention- bearing- refrencing, pointing- telling, reference. (2) showing reason, pretext- pretense- trick- stratagem, deception. (3) cause, pointing- referencing. (4) the place on which stands the cause called the Buddha, the Dhamma, the Sangha which are pointed- referenced- relied on. (5) telling, saying. (6)(a) pointing-referencing- swearing. (b) is pointed -referenced -sworn, he, witness.
